arabic: إِنَّ أَصْحَـٰبَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ٱلْيَوْمَ فِى شُغُلٍ فَـٰكِهُونَ
sahihInternational: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be amused in [joyful] occupation -
yusufAli: Verily the Companions of the Garden shall that Day have joy in all that they do;
urdu: اہل جنت اس روز عیش ونشاط کے مشغلے میں ہوں گے

sahihInternational: And comfort wherein they were amused.
yusufAli: And wealth (and conveniences of life), wherein they had taken such delight!
urdu: اور آرام کی چیزیں جن میں عیش کیا کرتے تھے

arabic: فَـٰكِهِينَ بِمَآ ءَاتَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ وَوَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
sahihInternational: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
yusufAli: Enjoying the (Bliss) which their Lord hath bestowed on them, and their Lord shall deliver them from the Penalty of the Fire.
urdu: جو کچھ ان کے پروردگار نے ان کو بخشا اس (کی وجہ) سے خوشحال۔ اور ان کے پروردگار نے ان کو دوزخ کے عذاب سے بچا لیا
